question: What plant did PM Modi plant on World Environment Day 2025?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Sindoor.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• PM Modi plants Sindoor sapling on World Environment Day.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Prime Minister Narendra Modi** planted a **Sindoor sapling** at his residence in **New Delhi**.

 
 
• 
 
The occasion was **World Environment Day**.

 
 
• 
 
The **plant was gifted** by the **brave women of Kutch, Gujarat**.

 
 
• 
 
These women showed **extraordinary courage** during the **1971 India-Pakistan war**.

 
 
• 
 
PM Modi called the **Sindoor plant** a **symbol of women's bravery and inspiration**.

 
 
• 
 
He recalled his **recent visit to Gujarat** where he received the gift.
